text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Whaaat! Bourbon-chan, you're still undecided on your appreciation campaign present...?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Are you gonna be okay~...? You have other work too, right? Should I just go ahead and do the inspection work by myself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No need to worry. Even while inspecting, present selection can be processed in the background.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Even now, I am extracting the optimal present criteria based on sample data............

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Data, huh... Overthinking these things isn't really the way to go, though~... Hmmmm.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! Why don't we play "Guess Who It Belongs To!" while we work?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A quiz, you say...? ...Inference: Judged to have no negative impact on work efficiency. Accepting order.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ta-da☆ Question 1! A copper coffee scoop! So stylish~! Now then, whose is it~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Creak! Snap... *chuckle*... *snicker*)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Unidentified anomalous noises detected in the surrounding vicinity. Inferred to belong to Cafe-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: C-Corrreeect~~...! B-But still, ghosts are strictly a no-go for an Umadol's broadcast...! O-On to the next one~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Question 2! An official URA Uma Blade! But huh? It looks waaaay old-school...☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Searching memory... Identified. If I recall correctly, its production count was exceptionally low due to various circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A so-called "collector's item"... Estimated to be someone with profound knowledge of horse girl racing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...! Solution computed. The one who chose this present is—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Digital-san. I infer that she went through great lengths to procure a hard-to-find item, believing her "fellow comrades" would appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Correeect~! Ahaha! You can totally picture her picking it out, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes... it is vivid in my mind. ...Status: "Heartwarming."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Now then, Question 3! ...Wait, what's this? A jar packed with... green pellets... capsules?

text_block_list.name: Bourbon & Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is rejected.
Wait, this is NOT okay~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —*Sigh*, good grief. Look closely, please... That is merely a deodorizer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: D-Deodorizer~~?! Whew, don't scare me! I totally thought it was one of your usual experiments...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Kukuku... Come now, what meaning is there in experimenting on a subject whose progress cannot be tracked?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That is merely a failed creation from an experiment... No, a byproduct! It was proven to have the effect of adsorbing foul odor components.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Which means it's handmade? Amazing~! That's a super-rare present!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Updating sample data... "It is not necessarily required to choose while thinking of the fans"... recorded.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, probability of fans being pleased is estimated to be high. In other words, it is "suitable as a present."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (I should have already known about her unwavering nature... And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Why... is this status occurring...? "Amused"...? "Pleased"...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, for every present, one could imagine the selection reasoning and the acquisition process...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hypothesis: The common factor is the "individuality" that cannot be learned through races or lives—in other words, "their authentic self." If one's thoughts can be directed toward that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Walking down the hallway, I spotted Mihono Bourbon and Smart Falcon walking together while chatting.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Conclusion. Fans find joy because, through the present, they can come to deeply understand the object of their interest—in other words, their "favorite."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...That is the logic behind it, correct?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~☆ ...Looks like you found your answer!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, thanks to you, I can now perceive what is important.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Transitioning to mission: Selection of "A Present True to Myself"!
choice_data_list: (Looks like the present issue got resolved!)
(Seems like the present issue is solved!)
